explanation: Apply the Fibonacci recurrence with boundary values F(0)=0 and F(1)=1. The function-level memoization cache retains results for later calls.
timeComplexity: O(n) newly computed states on a fresh query
spaceComplexity: O(n_max) retained cache for the largest n queried, plus recursion
